overlap_rationale: Model-level snapshot has no evaluation dataset. Dataset-specific exposure is documented: the bundle was trained on LUNA16, which consists of 888 LIDC-IDRI scans, so possible_training_overlap is yes for lidc_idri (thoraxbench.scoring.overlap). No documented exposure to NSCLC-Radiogenomics; that is not verified non-overlap. The pinned weights SHA-256 lives in src/thoraxbench/detectors/bundle.py, not here.
